title: Resolve a workplace layoff through its visible warning, severance, job search and next-day contract

steps.description: Align the controlled game clock to a normal workday before earning interview standing
Open the task board through the normal game navigation
Select real work tasks from the visible task board
Verify the high-value work task is visible and physically targetable before starting it
Start the system-migration work task through its visible UI button
Advance the controlled game clock by the task's seven in-game work hours
Process the elapsed task duration through the canonical task and work services
If elapsed game time surfaced a single-choice fate event, acknowledge it through its visible button and verify closure
Wait for the completed work task's real claim control to render
Claim the real task reward through its visible UI button to earn interview standing
Capture canonical performance after the UI-completed task
The task reward, not injected state, provides the performance required for a fair interview
Capture the authoritative employed state before the layoff warning
Open the normal career panel
Open a pressure-backed layoff warning through the visible career UI

steps.name: layoff-warning
steps.description: Record the warning and employer pressure before the response
Resolve a visible single-choice Fate event through its real choice button before selecting severance
Acknowledge the actual Fate result dialog and verify it has closed before selecting severance
Resolve a second visible single-choice Fate event through its real choice button
Acknowledge the second actual Fate result dialog and verify it has closed
Resolve a third visible single-choice Fate event through its real choice button
Acknowledge the third actual Fate result dialog and verify it has closed
Select the persisted severance route from the actual response buttons
Capture the authoritative wallet before severance settlement
Resolve any newly surfaced single-choice event before severance settlement through its real choice control
Acknowledge the visible event result and verify closure before severance settlement
Resolve a second single-choice event through its actual button if one appears
Acknowledge the second event result through its actual button if one appears
Resolve a third single-choice event through its actual button if one appears
Acknowledge the third event result and verify closure before severance settlement
Resolve layoff through the visible UI and wait for the saved unemployment state
Verify severance changed the authoritative wallet once
The gameplay severance was added to the shared wallet
The former employer is removed when unemployment begins

steps.name: layoff-unemployed
steps.description: Record the unemployed career panel and preserved job-search entry
If a single-outcome workplace event interrupts the career flow, dismiss it using its actual acknowledgement button
If a critical-message modal is present, open its visible conversation before selecting a reply
If the layoff message opens a real messenger conversation, choose its visible reply through the UI
Leave the current career page through normal navigation so newly dispatched critical messages use the runner's real modal recovery
After leaving the page, open any critical conversation dispatched by the route transition
Choose the real reply option if the route transition opened a critical conversation
Return to the career panel through the normal navigation after an event switches the current page
Open the existing employer recruitment list
If opening recruitment triggered a single-outcome workplace event, acknowledge it through the visible button and verify the modal closes
Restore the career tab after dismissing a route-interrupting event
Reopen the recruitment list through normal UI navigation before selecting a sect
Scroll the real recruitment board to the destination employer
Apply for an open destination-employer interview with a deterministic threshold the earned profile can meet
Confirm the visible application dialog through its actual interview-submit button
Wait for the actual interview choice
Acknowledge a single-outcome event that may interrupt the visible interview using its real button and verify closure
If a critical-message event interrupts, choose the visible conversation option and verify the real modal closes
Restore the career tab if the event routed to messages
Reopen the recruitment page after the event transition
Reconfirm the persistent interview application after restoring the recruitment page
Answer the interview with the delivery record
Wait for the persisted recruitment offer
Accept the offer through its visible UI control and wait for the persisted next-day contract
Advance the controlled game clock to the real daily settlement boundary
Run the canonical game loop so the existing day-settlement service records the day exactly once
If the real settlement summary is visible, close it through its 明天见 button and verify it disappears
Advance the controlled game clock to the next workday start
Run the canonical game loop to initialize the next game day and apply the pending contract
Confirm the canonical game day advanced before applying the pending contract
The new employer becomes active only on the contract's effective day
If the next workday presents the real boss one-on-one event, choose its visible career-planning option
Acknowledge the visible boss-event result through its real continue button
Confirm any boss-event popup closed before using home navigation
Open the normal home page to begin the newly effective contract's workday
Set the canonical work service to WORK so the next-day contract can earn ordinary wages
Advance ten in-game work minutes using the authoritative development clock so fractional wage remainders can settle
Accrue next-day wages through the canonical work and economy services
If work surfaces a single-choice Fate event, resolve it through the real choice button
Acknowledge any visible work-event result through its actual button
The new contract increases the shared wage wallet on its effective day
Read the authoritative daily wage ledger after work under the new contract
The effective-day wage is recorded in the daily salary ledger
Persist the re-employment contract and next-day wage through the normal save service
Close and relaunch the real Electron EXE with the same isolated profile
The wallet retains the newly earned next-day wage after restart
The new employment contract survives process restart
